title: AeroLat: Channel-Aware Latent Space Semantic Communication for Decentralized UAV Swarms
abstract: arXiv:2609.16947v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Communication in latent space offers an intriguing alternative to symbolic messages for decentralized autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarms operating over bandwidth-constrained, time-varying wireless links. However, when homogeneous frozen models are prompted with discretized perceptual inputs, their broadcast states collapse toward the shared prompt template. In view of this, we propose AeroLat, a channel-aware latent semantic communication framework that uses evidence injection. The resulting latent states are then passed through an explicit communication model that encompasses bandwidth-limited serialization, additive noise and information staleness, which facilitates a joint assessment of communication fidelity and swarm-level coordination. translated_title: AeroLat：面向去中心化无人机集群的信道感知潜在空间语义通信
translated_abstract: 对于在带宽受限、时变无线链路上运行的自主去中心化无人机集群而言，潜在空间通信为传统符号消息提供了一种颇具吸引力的替代方案。然而，当同质的冻结模型被输入离散化的感知数据时，其广播状态会坍缩向共享的提示模板。鉴于此，我们提出了AeroLat，一种采用证据注入机制的信道感知潜在语义通信框架。所产生的潜在状态随后经过一个显式通信模型处理，该模型涵盖带宽受限的序列化、加性噪声和信息陈旧性，从而能够对通信保真度与集群级协同进行联合评估。在多种子仿真实验中，AeroLat被证明对编解码器选择、故障以及集群规模的增长均保持鲁棒性，并能稳定复现潜在-集群异常现象，而no-white（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: AeroLat提出了一种基于证据注入的信道感知潜在空间语义通信框架，解决了去中心化无人机集群中潜在状态坍缩问题，并在带宽受限、含噪和时变信道下实现了通信保真度与集群协同的联合评估。
en_tdlr: AeroLat proposes a channel-aware latent semantic communication framework with evidence injection to prevent latent state collapse in decentralized UAV swarms, enabling joint assessment of communication fidelity and swarm-level coordination under bandwidth-limited, noisy, and time-varying channels.
